nodes.name: Touchscreen interface flexibility
nodes.statement: Touchscreen controls allow confirmation workflows and interface layouts to change in software without changing the arrangement of physical controls on the enclosure.

nodes.name: Acoustic echo cancellation
nodes.statement: Acoustic echo cancellation uses the signal being played by a device as a reference to estimate and reduce that playback's acoustic contribution to the microphone recording, while attempting to preserve the interlocutor's speech; successful suppression during simultaneous speech is not guaranteed.

nodes.name: Fan driver
nodes.statement: A two-wire fan can be switched with a suitable driver circuit despite lacking a separate PWM control pin; its operating current must not be supplied directly from a GPIO, and its rated voltage and current must be established before designing the connection.

nodes.name: Acoustic echo cancellation
nodes.statement: Acoustic echo cancellation commonly runs locally and reduces speaker output captured by the microphone, rather than removing unrelated noise such as a fan; it does not guarantee complete removal, and the available playback reference matters.

nodes.name: SPOTER clip representation
nodes.statement: The adapted VSL400 SPOTER takes 64 frames of 128 features, including hand and body coordinates, geometric relations, and detection flags; it projects features to 108 dimensions and uses a six-layer encoder, six-layer decoder, and one class query to aggregate the clip into a single representation for 400-class prediction.

nodes.name: Target-device benchmarking
nodes.statement: Real-time feasibility on Raspberry Pi 4B must be measured for camera capture, landmark extraction, SPOTER inference, and the full pipeline separately; unmeasured landmark FPS and inference-time estimates do not establish end-to-end real-time performance.

nodes.name: HDMI touchscreen connections
nodes.statement: Connecting a Raspberry Pi 4B to an HDMI touchscreen requires a compatible micro-HDMI-to-HDMI video path and, for a USB-touch model, a separate data-capable USB touch connection; display power must also meet the display's requirements.

nodes.name: Power integrity
nodes.statement: A reliable power design must meet peak load demand and maintain the required voltage at each device despite voltage drops in cables, connectors, and distribution paths; a supply's nameplate current rating alone does not establish stable operation under changing loads.

nodes.name: Power distribution budget
nodes.statement: A Raspberry Pi's supply capacity is not all available to peripherals because the Pi consumes part of it and its USB ports have separate delivery limits; peripheral loads and voltage requirements must be established before choosing a shared supply or deciding whether a powered USB hub is needed.

nodes.name: Raspberry Pi 4 USB current limit
nodes.statement: The Raspberry Pi 4 has a combined USB-port current limit of 1.2 A across all ports, not 1.2 A per port; the full current rating of its power adapter is not available to USB peripherals.

nodes.name: Hiệu năng Zipformer trên Pi
nodes.statement: Zipformer ONNX INT8 chạy CPU hai luồng trên Raspberry Pi 4B 8 GB qua hai lượt self dev20 cho prediction giống laptop và WER_ws 0,55%. Với 84,160 giây audio, hai lượt có inference 10,278 và 10,226 giây, wall time 14,644 và 14,578 giây; thời gian nạp model khoảng 3,74 giây và RAM cực đại toàn tiến trình khoảng 199 MiB.

nodes.name: Zipformer on Raspberry Pi
nodes.statement: On a Raspberry Pi 4B with 8 GB RAM and two CPU threads, Zipformer INT8 processed all 20 self-recorded WAVs totaling 84.160 seconds in each of two runs, matched the laptop predictions on all 20 utterances, and obtained 0.55% whitespace-tokenized WER and 0.16% CER. Inference took 10.278 and 10.226 seconds, with peak RSS of 199.06 and 198.32 MiB.

nodes.name: End-to-end latency
nodes.statement: End-to-end sign-language system latency includes capture, landmark or feature extraction, and prediction; model-only frames per second does not measure the complete delay.

nodes.name: End-to-end deployment cost
nodes.statement: Deployment cost on an edge device includes image acquisition, keypoint extraction, sequence buffering, and inference-time processing, not just the arithmetic cost of a coordinate transformation; experiment effort additionally includes data validation, cache construction, training, and analysis.

nodes.name: SPOTER điều chỉnh cho VSL400
nodes.statement: Cấu hình SPOTER trong VSL400_SPOTER_iteration_v1 giữ cache 64×128 và split của baseline, chiếu tuyến tính 128→108, dùng vị trí học cho 64 frame và đầu ra 400 lớp, không trích lại landmark hay thêm chuẩn hóa và augmentation; 128 đặc trưng gồm nhiều loại thông tin, không phải 64 điểm 2D, và cờ phát hiện không phải mặt nạ bỏ frame.
